test_cases.scenario_name: Validate initial rendering and attributes of TodoMVC input field
test_steps: Verify placeholder text equals 'What needs to be done?'.
Verify element is enabled (disabled equals false) and editable (readonly equals false).
Verify value_present is false on initial page load.
expected_results: Input field is displayed, enabled, empty, and displays the placeholder 'What needs to be done?'.
evidence: ui_discovery_report.json: inputs[0] with placeholder 'What needs to be done?', disabled: false, readonly: false, value_present: false

test_cases.scenario_name: Attempt empty submission on TodoMVC input field
test_steps: Locate input[placeholder='What needs to be done?'].
Send Enter keystroke without typing any characters.
Check whether empty todo item is prevented from creation.
expected_results: No empty todo item is added to the application state or interface.
evidence: ui_discovery_report.json: inputs[0] placeholder 'What needs to be done?'

test_cases.scenario_name: Boundary string length input in TodoMVC input field
test_steps: Focus on input[placeholder='What needs to be done?'].
Type a single character string ('A') and press Enter.
Focus on input[placeholder='What needs to be done?'].
Type a large character string (e.g., 255 characters or 1000 characters) and press Enter.
Observe the resulting UI items and verify input handling and layout stability.
expected_results: Application accepts valid single-character task ('A') and displays it in the list.
Application accepts and handles the boundary long string task without breaking the UI layout.
